:project_type: mediawiki

== Project Notes

=== Extension overview

Matomo is a MediaWiki extension that adds privacy-friendly Matomo pageview
tracking. It tracks only which pages are viewed, how often, and in what
sequence — no personally identifiable information is collected. The core
logic lives in `src/Hooks.php`; the tracking snippet is delivered as a
ResourceLoader module (`resources/ext.matomo.tracker/`).
